input_integrity.triangle_ids_in_local_reports: final-change-solution head_triangles indices; actual geometry is verified exact float32

method: All actual-float32 changed eye vertices: same baseline area-weighted vertex normal defines inward rays from before/after positions, starting0.025mm inward; accept first opposing-oriented hit (<−0.2 normal dot) beyond0.06mm and within8mm. This is a paired local regression screen, not a global minimum-wall certificate.
limitations: Large chord reductions can change the opposing target from a distant surface across a concavity to a nearer rim; inspect hit coordinates rather than interpreting such values as physical material losses.
Normals are held to the baseline for paired comparison; curved rims and very oblique directions can give tangential chords rather than manufacturing wall thickness.
No physical printing or resin strength criterion is established. Threshold counts are descriptive regression flags, not acceptance certification.
A missing opposing hit is reported, never replaced by a fabricated thickness.
